flow.script_punct_help: Swaps “ ” and 「 」 along with the characters.
flow.reset_body: The whole profile goes back to the "{preset}" template: engines, script conversions, switches, main language, writing style, examples and the applications it applies to. The name stays.
flow.reset_missing_body: The template this profile was made from is not in this version. It can be reset to the "Casual" template instead: the whole profile, engines and applications included, goes back to casual. The name stays.
flow.manage_preset_hint: Made from the "{preset}" template; a reset returns to it.
flow.panel.insert_outcome.copied: copied to the clipboard, nothing put into the application
flow.panel.insert_outcome.secure_input: shown on the panel, the field was a secure input
flow.panel.insert_outcome.app_changed: shown on the panel, the front application had changed
flow.panel.insert_outcome.not_trusted: shown on the panel, no accessibility permission
flow.panel.insert_outcome.clipboard_fail: shown on the panel, the clipboard refused the text
flow.panel.insert_outcome.empty_text: nothing to put in, the text was empty
